title: HDB hits 4,000-unit PPHS target and who gets priority for these rental flats
asked: Whether HDB reached its target of 4,000 units under the Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme by the end of 2025, and what that means for the success rate of just married or affianced couples applying to the scheme.
response: HDB met its target of ramping up PPHS supply to 4,000 units at the end of 2025. Allocation is tiered: households with at least one child aged 18 and below and married couples expecting a child get highest priority, then married couples without children and households with older children, then fiancé-fiancée couples. In recent exercises, all households in the highest priority tier and about 30% of the next tier were invited to select PPHS flats. The Minister said about 4,000 flats is the right steady state, alongside ramping up Shorter Waiting Time flats.

key_points.point: HDB reached the 4,000-unit PPHS supply target at the end of 2025
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: HDB has met its target of ramping up the PPHS supply to 4,000 units at the end of 2025.

key_points.point: Highest priority goes to households with a child aged 18 and below and married couples expecting a child
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: households with at least one child aged 18 and below, as well as married couples expecting a child are given highest priority

key_points.point: Priority order after that: married couples without children and households with older children, then fiancé-fiancée couples
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: Married couples without children and households with older children are next in priority, followed by fiancé-fiancée couples.

key_points.point: In recent exercises, all highest-tier households and about 30% of the next tier were invited to select PPHS flats
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: all households in the highest priority tier and about 30% of households in the next priority tier were invited to select PPHS flats

key_points.point: About 4,000 flats is assessed as the right steady state, alongside ramping up Shorter Waiting Time flats
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: Our assessment is that about 4,000 flats, and maybe just a little bit more, would be the right steady state.

key_points.point: The Ministry is looking at as many vacant SERS flats as possible, but vacant flat supply is limited
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: we are looking to see as many of the SERS vacant flats as we can. But there is a limited supply of vacant flats.

key_points.point: Lease Buyback Scheme units that can be resold should be sold to buyers, leaving only some available for rental
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: For those that come back from the LBS, the ones that can be resold, those should be sold to those who can purchase.

key_points.point: The PPHS ramp-up followed the COVID-period housing crunch, and with the building programme caught up the scheme is expected to reach a steady state
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: we anticipate we should be able to get to a steady state for the PPHS flats

left_open: A success rate figure specifically for just married or affianced couples applying to the scheme.
supplementary: Whether other sources of flats, such as vacant SERS units and Lease Buyback Scheme returned units, could be tapped to shorten the PPHS queue.
